gate: Lived experience wants to come out as a story. That is the felt shape of this code, a low steady pressure to turn what was lived into something tellable, to find the angle that makes another person lean in. A person carrying this drive notices the narrative inside an ordinary day before anyone asks for one. The trip to the market becomes a small tale on the way home. The argument becomes a scene with its own timing. Stimulation is the word the lineage uses for it, and it fits, because the work is to keep the field interesting, to keep the listener awake inside their own life. The misread is to call this performance, or showing off, or a need for attention. It is none of those. The code is doing its actual job when it turns raw experience into a shape another person can step inside. Without that translation the experience stays private and stops there. With it, the experience becomes something shared.
centre_field: This drive is wired to the part of you that turns inner motion into outer act, the place where thought and feeling become voice. Everything moving in a person is reaching for that exit, looking for a way to leave the body and enter the room. For storytelling to live here, at the broadcast point, is the whole teaching. Telling is not a flourish on top of thinking. It is the manifestation gesture itself, the way an idea actually crosses from inside to outside and lands in someone else. A cost is also wired into the placement. This is the part of you that wears out first if it is overworked. A teller who talks past their own timing, who broadcasts without pause, will exhaust the very instrument they need. Honour the silences as part of the song.
channel: Telling without an idea to carry is noise dressed up as meaning. This code reaches upward toward the part of you that gathers ideas, that watches patterns form and holds them as something thinkable. The lineage calls that connection the channel of curiosity. The reach matters in a specific direction. Ideas alone stay abstract, suspended in the mind, never quite touching anyone. The story is what gives an idea legs, a setting, a person inside it the listener can recognise. Stimulation needs something to be about. Without that upstream feed of concept and pattern, the teller starts narrating thin material and feels the dissatisfaction of it. Without the downstream exit through this drive, the idea stays in one head and never finds an audience. Joined, concept becomes narrative, narrative sparks new concept, and the loop keeps feeding itself. This code lacks the source on its own. It is a mouth waiting for something worth saying.
